name: Settings Panel
description: A dark settings card: rows stagger in, switches fill once they land, sections cross-fade as the card eases to height, and a save bar counts unsaved changes.

props.name: sections
props.type: { id: string; label: string; description?: string; rows: SettingsRow[] }[]
props.description: One tab per section. A row is { kind: "toggle" | "segmented" | "select" | "text", id, label, hint? } plus options (segmented, select) or placeholder/prefix (text).

props.name: initialValues
props.description: Saved values keyed by row id. Changes are compared against these to drive the unsaved count; rows without one start off, empty or on their first option.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called on Save or ⌘S. Return a promise to hold the saving state; reject it to show the error state with Try again. Defaults to a 900ms fake save.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: switches that are on and the Save button. Monochrome by default.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette; also sets color-scheme so native selects match.
